manifest.name: Shipping original logs
manifest.description: Original immutable synthetic JSONL inGitDB collections. Baseline observations, a synthetic carrier-gateway stream with only healthy11038 booking, and explicitly labelled future replay examples remain separate.

source.notes: Public synthetic training companion to Northwind; no real shipment or partner call is represented.

meaning.name: Shipping original logs
meaning.description: Original immutable synthetic JSONL inGitDB collections. Baseline observations, a synthetic carrier-gateway stream with only healthy11038 booking, and explicitly labelled future replay examples remain separate.

concepts.label: Shipping log entry
concepts.description: One immutable synthetic JSONL observation. Event IDs and sequences belong to their stream and attempt context; source collections keep observed baseline and future recovery examples separate.

concepts.label: Baseline observation
concepts.description: An observation in the original baseline streams. The carrier-gateway baseline contains only the healthy order 11038 booking; it is not evidence that blocked orders 11045 or 11062 were booked.

concepts.label: Carrier gateway log entry
concepts.description: A simulated outbound booking request or response in a carrier-gateway stream. These synthetic entries represent neither a real carrier API call nor physical shipping; future replay streams remain examples.

concepts.label: Recovery log example
concepts.description: A separately stored illustration of a possible future replay for blocked orders 11045 or 11062. These records are not baseline observations, executed recovery evidence, or proof that the pending 11062 replay happened.

concepts.label: Shipping attempt reference
concepts.description: An attempt identifier referring to the Shipping attempt concept. Baseline IDs can correspond to recorded attempts; future example IDs need not exist in the Shipping baseline. This semantic reference creates no cross-database foreign key.

concepts.label: Shipping request reference
concepts.description: The shipping request identifier carried by the simulated carrier-gateway message. This declares the identifier meaning without asserting a SQL join or a completed carrier assignment.

concepts.label: Scenario order reference
concepts.description: The scenario order identifier associated with the log entry. Orders 11038, 11045 and 11062 reuse Northwind order identifiers; 90001–90005 are synthetic controls that need not resolve to Northwind rows. This semantic reference creates no enforced foreign key or automatic join.

concepts.label: Event kind
concepts.description: The kind of synthetic observation, such as request-created, replay-started or booking-confirmed. A kind found in a recovery-example collection remains illustrative.

concepts.label: Event time
concepts.description: The timestamp recorded for the synthetic observation, qualified by clock_domain and precision_ms. A future example timestamp does not establish that an action occurred.

concepts.label: Clock domain
concepts.description: The clock whose timestamps the record uses. Clock domains must be considered before comparing event times across streams.

concepts.label: Event sequence
concepts.description: The recorded event order within a stream and attempt. Sequence numbers are not a global order across collections or a substitute for clock-domain-aware time comparisons.

concepts.label: Correlation identifier
concepts.description: The scenario identifier relating a gateway exchange to its Shipping request. It correlates records without proving successful processing.

concepts.label: Simulated booking status
concepts.description: An optional status on a simulated carrier response. A booked status in a recovery example is illustrative and does not establish an executed replay or a real shipment.

concepts.label: Simulated booking reference
concepts.description: An optional reference returned by the synthetic booking simulation. Example references are not evidence of a real booking, carrier call or shipment.

tableDescriptions.baseline: Original baseline synthetic shipping-process observations for healthy and blocked orders.
tableDescriptions.carrierGateway: Original baseline simulated carrier booking exchange for healthy order 11038 only.
tableDescriptions.recovery11045example: Separate future replay illustration for order 11045; not observed baseline or executed recovery evidence.
tableDescriptions.recovery11062example: Separate future replay illustration for order 11062, whose replay is pending; not executed recovery evidence.
tableDescriptions.carrierGatewayRecovery11045example: Separate simulated carrier-gateway exchange illustrating a future order 11045 replay; not a real carrier call.
tableDescriptions.carrierGatewayRecovery11062example: Separate simulated carrier-gateway exchange illustrating a future order 11062 replay; not an executed replay or real carrier call.

source.notes: Public synthetic training companion to Northwind; no real shipment or partner call is represented.
